bounce.$description: snappy's bounce (SwiftUI's default for .snappy); SwiftUI's spring(duration:bounce:): Compose takes dampingRatio = 1 - bounce and stiffness = (2π / duration)²
smooth has no bounce; SwiftUI's spring(duration:bounce:): Compose takes dampingRatio = 1 - bounce and stiffness = (2π / duration)²

duration.$description: Theme.Motion.expand: Animation.smooth(duration: 0.4), a block unfolding in place
Theme.Motion.revealTime: what opens in the chat shows itself
Theme.Motion.concealTime: closing folds it away first, quicker
Theme.Motion.drawer: interpolatingSpring(duration: 0.32, bounce: 0), a drawer let go

stiffness.$description: Theme.Motion.keyboard: interpolatingSpring(mass: 1, stiffness: 555.027, damping: 47.118), the system keyboard's spring

duration.$description: Theme.Motion.composerSwap: Animation.timingCurve(0.38, 0.7, 0.125, 1, duration: 0.4), send growing into the composer's round button's place and leaving it, and the scale and blur that go with it

curveX1.$description: composerSwap's cubic Bezier, first control point x

curveY1.$description: composerSwap's cubic Bezier, first control point y

curveX2.$description: composerSwap's cubic Bezier, second control point x

curveY2.$description: composerSwap's cubic Bezier, second control point y

fadeDuration.$description: Theme.Motion.composerSwapFade: Animation.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), what fades with the swap fades faster than it grows

blur.$description: Theme.Motion.composerSwapBlur: the blur send clears as it grows in, and takes on as it leaves (points on iOS, dp on Android)

from.$description: Theme.Motion.composerSwapFrom: where send grows from at the right edge, this small and not zero so the scale has a size to start at

scale.$description: Theme.Motion.composerSwapScale: what stop and voice shrink to (and grow from) as they fade
Theme.Motion.composerPressScale: send pressed down shrinks to this

duration.$description: Theme.Motion.composerPress: Animation.easeOut(duration: 0.4), shrinking slowly while pressed

releaseDuration.$description: Theme.Motion.composerRelease: Animation.timingCurve(0.38, 0.7, 0.125, 1, duration: 0.25), coming back quicker when let go, on composerSwap's curve

duration.$description: Theme.Motion.needsYouBreathDuration: one breath of the Needs You ring

scale.$description: Theme.Motion.needsYouBreathScale: the ring grows to 1 + scale times the dot as it fades

ringOpacity.$description: Theme.Motion.needsYouRingOpacity: the ring's color opacity at the start of a breath

reduced.$description: with reduced motion every duration is zero; components also stop their loops
